entries.title: Building (grammar)
entries.description: One grammar for buildings: footprint (rect, L, U, courtyard), storeys, wall style, openings, corner towers, roof (gable, hip, flat, battlements, eave roofs), details. Also accepts the house generator's flat parameters. Presets: house, cottage, shop, townhouse, cottage-garden, arched-townhouse, tower, castle-keep, pagoda, temple-hall, minka, gate-tower, tea-room, white-pagoda, siheyuan, barn, town-hall, apartment-block, courtyard-fort, lighthouse, warehouse, manor, modular-bakery, modular-town-hall, modular-flats, modular-tea-house.

footprint.description: Plan shape of the ground floor

shape.description: rect, L, U (two wings round a notch) or courtyard (ring round an open yard)

notch_corner.description: L: which corner is cut away

notch_side.description: U: which side the notch opens to

court_width.description: Courtyard: width of the open yard

court_depth.description: Courtyard: depth of the open yard

storeys.description: Storeys stacked on the footprint; each is wall courses plus a floor band

courses.description: Wall height of each storey in brick courses (a door needs 6)

top_courses.description: Courses of the top storey; 0 = same as the others

setback.description: Studs each upper storey steps in on every side (rect footprints)

floors.description: Fill the interior with floor plates (off = ring bands only)

band_projection.description: Studs the floor bands project as a cornice

eaves.description: A small hip roof round every storey but the top (pagoda, temple); needs setback 1 or more

interior.description: Rooms: a partition wall with a doorway on every storey (rectangular footprints)

style.description: brick; half-timber (posts and infill); stone (two-tone random bricks)

thickness.description: Wall thickness in studs; 2 uses staggered rows

alt_colour.description: Second colour (stone mix, timber infill accent)

plinth.description: First course in a plinth colour

accent_every.description: Every n-th course in the accent colour (0 = none)

openings.description: Doors and windows, sized from real parts

door.description: Door leaf style (4 studs wide, 6 courses tall)

door_position.description: Where the door sits along the facade

ground_windows.description: Window kind on the ground floor (wide = two 4-stud windows side by side)

rhythm.description: Spacing: minimum pier 1, 2 or 3 studs between openings

count.description: Windows per facade (0 = as many as fit)

above_door.description: A window above the door on upper floors

sills.description: Projecting sill plate under every rect, small, tall and wide window that has a wall course below it

shutters.description: Coloured shutter bricks on both sides of every rect, small, tall and wide window

keystones.description: Arch windows: a keystone brick in the course above the arch

style.description: plain interlocking corners, coloured pillars, or corner towers

tower_shape.description: Square tower (any size) or round tower (4x4 round bricks)

tower_size.description: Square tower size in studs (round towers are 4)

tower_proud.description: Studs the tower sticks out of the corner

tower_extra_courses.description: Courses the tower rises above the top storey band

style.description: gable, hip, flat deck (with optional parapet), or none

ridge.description: Ridge direction (auto = along the longer side)

tiers.description: Slope courses; 0 = as steep as the depth allows

finial.description: Hip roofs: a cone finial on the peak

gable_windows.description: Gable roofs: a small window in each gable end

sign.description: Shop sign band above the ground floor

flower_boxes.description: Flower boxes on the window sills (turns sills on)

fence.description: Picket fence round the garden at the edge of the base plate, open where the path crosses it

connectors.description: Technic pin bricks in the side walls near the top of every storey, to bolt modules together

kind.description: none, a plate round the building, or a 32x32 modular-building plate with a sidewalk

margin.description: Studs of ground around the building

path.description: Path from the door to the edge

sidewalk.description: Modular: studs of sidewalk in front of the building

lamps.description: Modular: two street lamps on the sidewalk

width.description: House dialect: front wall width in studs (even)

depth.description: House dialect: side wall length in studs (even)

courses.description: House dialect: wall height in courses (12 or more makes two storeys)

door_side.description: House dialect: where the door sits on the front

windows.description: House dialect: windows in total, spread over window_sides

roof_tiers.description: House dialect: slope courses (0 = as steep as fits)

porch.description: House dialect: pillared porch over the door

chimney.description: House dialect: chimney on the ridge

dormer.description: House dialect: dormer window (not built by the grammar yet; reported)

entries.quality: Role-tagged, running-bond walls with real window and door parts; one connected component by construction.

house.title: House
house.description: Two-storey brick house: gable roof with chimney, porch, plinth, tall windows.

cottage.title: Cottage
cottage.description: Low half-timbered cottage: one tall storey, steep gable roof, chimney, small windows.

shop.title: Shop with flat roof
shop.description: Corner-shop style: glazed door beside a wide display window, sign band, flat roof with a plain parapet, flat above.

townhouse.title: Two-storey townhouse
townhouse.description: Narrow brick townhouse with a hip roof, cornice bands, arched windows and a balcony over the door.

cottage-garden.title: Cottage with garden
cottage-garden.description: Brick cottage with sills, green shutters, flower boxes, a gable window and a white picket fence.

arched-townhouse.title: Townhouse with keystones
arched-townhouse.description: Townhouse with arched windows crowned by keystones, sills and shutters.

tower.title: Tower
tower.description: Tall square stone tower: arrow slits, a gate, battlements on top.

castle-keep.title: Castle keep
castle-keep.description: Square keep with four corner towers, battlements, arrow slits and a barred gate.

pagoda.title: Pagoda (4 tiers)
pagoda.description: Four-tier pagoda: every storey steps in and carries its own hip roof; cone finial on the top roof.

temple-hall.title: Temple hall
temple-hall.description: Chinese temple hall: red walls and pillars, broad yellow hip roof, pillared porch, cornice band.

minka.title: Japanese farmhouse (minka)
minka.description: Japanese minka: low white-and-timber walls, deep dark hip roof, wide windows, timber porch.

gate-tower.title: City gate tower
gate-tower.description: Two-storey gate tower: barred gate below, eave roof round the lower storey, yellow hip roof above.

tea-room.title: Tea room
tea-room.description: Small square tea pavilion: white walls, brown pillars, steep green hip roof with a finial.

white-pagoda.title: Japanese pagoda (3 tiers)
white-pagoda.description: Three-tier pagoda: white plaster storeys, dark roofs, wide eaves, finial.

siheyuan.title: Courtyard house (siheyuan)
siheyuan.description: Chinese courtyard house: a ring of rooms round an open yard, grey walls, red parapet, red door.

barn.title: Barn
barn.description: Big gabled barn: wide barred doors, small high windows, overhanging roof.

town-hall.title: Town hall
town-hall.description: Civic building: hip roof, white corner pillars, cornice bands, wide windows, balcony over the door.

apartment-block.title: Apartment block
apartment-block.description: Four-storey block: flat roof with parapet, rows of tall windows, projecting floor bands.

courtyard-fort.title: Courtyard fort
courtyard-fort.description: Square fort round an open parade ground, four round corner towers with cone roofs, battlements.

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
lighthouse.description: Tall striped tower: red and white courses, arrow-slit windows, conical roof with a finial.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Long low warehouse: flat roof with a plain parapet, loading gate, rows of wide windows.

manor.title: Manor house
manor.description: U-shaped manor with a courtyard open to the front, stone walls, corner pillars and a flat battlemented roof.

modular-bakery.title: Modular bakery
modular-bakery.description: Three-storey modular bakery: shop front and glazed door with sign band, arched flats above, balcony, chimney, gable roof.

modular-town-hall.title: Modular town hall
modular-town-hall.description: Civic module: hip roof, white pillars, cornice bands, balcony over the central door, wide windows.

modular-flats.title: Modular apartment block
modular-flats.description: Four-storey flats module: flat roof with parapet, tall windows in rows, projecting floor bands, shop door.

modular-tea-house.title: Modular tea house
modular-tea-house.description: Asian-style module: red walls, dark brown pillars, yellow hip roof, arched upper windows, sidewalk lamps.
